message.content: In the discussions about the community garden, it was mentioned that soft white lights were suggested to create a warm and inviting atmosphere. Specifically, MuradinBronzebeard expressed that "soft white lights will definitely create a warm ambiance." ArthasMenethil also agreed with this preference, stating that "soft white lights will definitely create a warm ambiance." Therefore, soft white lights are the preferred type of lighting for the seating area in the community garden.
